thread:
Marta: FYI: staging reported two OOMs at ~11:15 during a long 32k-context run. The runtime fell back to the small-model, but client errors spiked. @Dinesh can you triage?

Dinesh: Looking. Quick skim of allocator logs shows lots of small frees and a fragmented slab pool. Allocator tries to satisfy 16-32MB contiguous KV pages and fails because the largest_free run is fragmented into many <8MB holes. Eviction does happen, but coalescer is rarely invoked.

Ryan: Did we change anything that increases peak per-request allocation size? Kernel selection or batching? Those change slab request patterns.

Marta: We rolled a batching tweak yesterday to increase max_batch_token_window 2048->4096 to boost throughput. Could be related.

Sophie: Paste profiler snapshot when you have it. I want to see breakdown: metadata, index, slab pools, and coalescer stats.

Dinesh: Profiler excerpt: 

---- profiler dump ----
KV_index_total: 2.05G
slab_small (4k-256k): 160MB (fragments=4.1k)
slab_mid (256k-4M): 320MB (fragments=1.7k)
slab_large (4M-64M): 1.2GB (free_runs=142, largest_free_run=18MB)
coalescer.last_run: 2023-11-30T10:02:10Z (cold)
page_spills: 0
alloc_hot: runtime::kv_alloc_contig, runtime::evict_bucket
---- end ----

Dinesh: Root cause seems fragmentation of slab_large. Requests needing >18MB contig pages fail and trigger OOM. Eviction frees pieces but without compaction they're unusable for large allocations.

Ryan: OK. Propose immediate mitigations: 1) revert batch-window change on staging to reduce peak alloc sizes; 2) enable experimental async page-spill-to-disk to give allocator breathing room; 3) add a best-effort split-allocation fallback so a single large KV page can be served as multiple shards to avoid hard OOMs.

Sophie: For the split fallback, we need a correctness check: ensure reads/writes across split shards maintain ordering and cache keys map deterministically. Also measure tail-latency impact.

Dinesh: Implementation sketch I have: 

```
ptr = alloc_contig(size)
if (!ptr) {
  if (page_spill_flag) async_spill_lru_pages();
  // try again after spill window
  ptr = alloc_contig(size);
}
if (!ptr) {
  // fallback: attempt split allocation into N shards (allowed if size <= max_splitable)
  ptr = alloc_split_shards(size);
}
if (!ptr) {
  // signal OOM upstack
  return OOM;
}
```

Dinesh: We'll also emit telemetry counters: kv.split_fallbacks, kv.page_spills, kv.coalescer_runs, kv.fragmentation_ratio (free_runs/total_runs).

Marta: Action items for immediate triage:
- revert batching tweak on staging (Marta)
- flip page-spill feature flag on staging (Dinesh)
- implement minimal split-allocation fallback with canary gating (Ryan)
- add alert: fragmentation_ratio > 0.6 triggers P3 and auto-annotate runbook (Sophie)

Ryan: Note: split-allocation will add per-request tail work and increase RPCs to backend storage for KV fetch. We should rollout to 5% traffic first and measure p95/p99. Add metric kv.split_tail_latency.

Sophie: I'll write an e2e repro harness that simulates long ctx sessions mixing tiny writes and occasional 20-30MB inserts to exercise fragmentation. The test will run with profiler flags and dump slab histograms. Scheduling tomorrow morning.

Marta: For medium-term fixes: we should implement a cooperative slab_compact job that runs during low CPU utilization and yields periodically so it doesn't disturb latency. Also tune coalescer to run more frequently when fragmentation_ratio above threshold.

Dinesh: Agree. Prototype plan: cooperative_compact() walks free-run list and coalesces adjacent free runs; break every 5ms to yield to worker threads. Expose throttle "compact_yield_ms". We'll also add a mode to trigger on fragmentation_ratio and not just time.

Sophie: Also add unit/integration tests validating split-read correctness and that compaction doesn't corrupt live allocations. We should include a fuzz test for split/shard boundary conditions.

infra-bot: deploy:staging rolled back 1836002201 -> 1836002195 by marta (reason: revert batching window). :white_check_mark:

Marta: I'll file a tracking ticket with owners and deadlines. Target: basic split-fallback + page-spill telemetry + staging canary by EOD. Medium-term compaction work slated for next sprint.

Ryan: cc @sre-oncall for the new alert rule and runbook updates. Please add an emergency fallback section describing how to force-enable split-fallback cluster-wide.

Sophie: I'll drop the repro script and the profiler command lines in this thread once it's uploaded so anyone can replay locally.

Dinesh: I'll push the page-spill flag and a telemetry PR. WIll create a follow-up RFC for the cooperative compactor algorithm and scheduling.
